salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-2 (c2-openai). Model-harness comparison of agent runtimes (core models x harnesses on SWE-bench-45, Terminal-Bench 2, VitaBench, LOCA-Bench, ClawMark, AgentSkillOS). The only OpenAI entry is the fixed native reference 'GPT-5.5 xhigh + Codex CLI' (a complete system outside the crossed panel; Codex CLI as a harness also appears with the other, non-OpenAI core models: not converted). Cells of that row: Table 2 (main, Best-of-4 / Mean-of-4: SWE-bench-45, TB2, VitaBench, LOCA, ClawMark, AgentSkillOS 200 skills), Table 17 (VitaBench Delivery / In-store / OTA / Cross; the Total cell repeats Table 2), Table 24 (ClawMark Full Success), Table 26 (AgentSkillOS 900 skills; the 200-skill cell repeats Table 2), Table 29 (mean primary Token Load, million tokens per scheduled attempt: usage of the corresponding measure) and Table 30 (tokens per success and coverage: notes). Cells repeated in Tables 13, 16, 19, 24, 26, 30 are kept as notes on the first measure, not as second measures (same setup, same model). Effort xhigh and harness Codex CLI written ('GPT-5.5 xhigh with Codex CLI'); route not written (the harness is the system); no money cost. Scores 0-100.
